name: madmallard-pr-review-toolkit
description: Evidence-first pull request code review across six targeted modes with connected GitHub tooling.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use Mad Mallard PR Review Toolkit to review this GitHub pull request for regressions, missing tests, silent failures and merge blockers.
